values.subject: Administration: The team-building registration channel is now open; preliminary group sizes have been drafted
values.body_text: The registration channel opens today. Based on the current staffing levels, here is a preliminary breakdown of group sizes: Procurement 12 people, Quality 10 people, Logistics 14 people, Planning 8 people, for a total of 44 people. We will collect individual colleagues’ travel restrictions separately; in the summary, we will provide you only with the numbers and categories and will not include them in a sheet visible to everyone.
